Writing memory managers are a difficult task. We have two basic options. First one is that we implement a full blown Garbage Collector that can scan the entire stack and heap for possible memory regions having no reference stored anywhere anymore, other is we implement a Memory Checker that’ll check if allocated memory objects are free’d or not.
